reference_type: validated standard-method result; no measured biological force truth

baseline.method: Original author scalar Young-Dupre and variational Laplace on the exact full64-cell real microscopy-derived mesh

threshold_provenance: Independent full original repeat, three LAPACK drivers in float64/float32, and serialization, frozen before local extraction. Each error limit is five times measured worst backend NRMSE, with nonzero floor; see validation.
alignment: None. Every interface and region is evaluated, in geometric label order. Gauge is mean tension1, exterior pressure0.
nrmse_definition: sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)), evaluated separately for all357 tensions and all65 region pressures.
physics_definition: Relative L2 norm of Vcell(D^T gamma-Vcell^T p) normalized by ||Vcell D^T gamma||. Explicit triangle derivatives from public geometry; this is pressure normal-equation consistency, not physical truth or zero vertex force.
